youtube.title: In 1518, a Whole City Couldn't Stop Dancing | The Dancing Plague
youtube.description:
July 1518, Strasbourg: Frau Troffea began dancing in the street and couldn't stop. Within a week, more than thirty joined her; by some accounts, hundreds by August. The city's first cure? More dancing.

📂 Case File #006: The Dancing Plague of 1518

Sources: John Waller, "A Time to Dance, a Time to Die" (2008); overview: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dancing_plague_of_1518
Images: Hondius after Bruegel (public domain; one print via Wellcome Collection, CC BY 4.0); Nuremberg Chronicle (1493).
Narration voice: AI.
